scenarios.description: Measure picker input to a selectable destination and selection to a verified T3 receipt and Submitted presentation.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Open the destination picker on a completed recording, then select an existing thread.
prerequisites: Manual performance-benchmark workflow on standard GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 with published full revision SHAs.
Dedicated hosted CPU accounting with unrelated load, guest steal, throttling and I/O below the focused benchmark thresholds.
expectedEvidence: A trusted click, a selectable row, the exact synthetic dispatch payload, an independent receiver acceptance, the durable sent receipt and the visible Submitted indicator.
Separate fresh and prewarmed catalogue trials, normalized score, matched repeat deltas, CPU, PSS, storage, interference and span attribution.
limits: Runs the production Electron renderer and Handoff code with a synthetic native parent and loopback T3 receiver. Real clipboard, native compositor, OS focus restoration and real T3 acceptance require their existing verification lanes.
